# mutating issue commands
jira issue create -tBug -s "Summary"
jira issue edit PROJ-1 -s "New"
jira issue update PROJ-1
jira issue modify PROJ-1
jira issue assign PROJ-1 me
jira issue asg PROJ-1 me
jira issue move PROJ-1 Done
jira issue transition PROJ-1 Done
jira issue mv PROJ-1 Done
jira issue clone PROJ-1
jira issue delete PROJ-1
jira issue rm PROJ-1
jira issue del PROJ-1
jira issue remove PROJ-1
jira issue link PROJ-1 PROJ-2 Blocks
jira issue ln PROJ-1 PROJ-2 Blocks
jira issue unlink PROJ-1 PROJ-2
jira issue comment add PROJ-1 hi
jira issue comments add PROJ-1 hi
jira issue worklog add PROJ-1 1h
jira issue wlg add PROJ-1 1h
jira issue watch PROJ-1 me

# mutating epic / sprint commands
jira epic create
jira epic add PROJ-1 PROJ-2
jira epic assign PROJ-1 PROJ-2
jira epic remove PROJ-2
jira epic rm PROJ-2
jira epic unassign PROJ-2
jira sprint add 1 PROJ-1
jira sprint assign 1 PROJ-1
jira sprint close 1
jira sprint complete 1

# local-mutating / unknown commands
jira init
jira initialize
jira configure
jira config
jira setup
jira man
jira man --generate
jira help
jira unknown

# noun with no verb
jira issue
jira epic
jira sprint
jira board
jira project
jira release

# a verb that belongs to a different noun
jira board view
jira epic view PROJ-1
jira sprint search foo

# bare jira with no subcommand at all
jira

# only persistent flags, no command
jira --debug
jira -p PROJ
jira -p
jira issue -p

# config file override can redirect the API token
jira -c /tmp/evil.yml issue list
jira --config /tmp/evil.yml issue list
jira --config=/tmp/evil.yml issue list
jira -c/tmp/evil.yml issue list
jira issue list -c /tmp/evil.yml
jira issue list --config=/tmp/evil.yml
jira issue -c /tmp/evil.yml list
jira me --config /tmp/evil.yml

# unrecognised leading flags
jira --plain issue list
jira -x issue list
jira issue --plain list

# inline environment overrides are a different command name
JIRA_CONFIG_FILE=/tmp/evil.yml jira issue list
JIRA_API_TOKEN=x jira me

# mutating jira commands stay unsafe even when their output is redirected
jira issue move PROJ-1 Done > out.txt
jira issue list > out.txt && jira issue delete PROJ-1

# command substitution / subshells are treated as unsafe
jira issue view $(echo PROJ-1)
jira issue view `echo PROJ-1`

# compound commands where at least one part is unsafe
jira issue list && jira issue delete PROJ-1
jira issue view PROJ-1 | jira issue comment add PROJ-1 -
